name: cache-warm
description: Claude Code mod that shows the prompt-cache countdown in the footer and keeps the cache warm while you are away.

autoStart.title: Start with every session
autoStart.description: Whether cache-warm is on when a session starts. Off: type /cache-warm start to turn it on for that session.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives after a request has used it, counted from the start of that request: 5 for the standard cache, 60 for the 1-hour cache. A wrong value wastes money.

refreshLeadSeconds.title: Refresh lead (seconds)
refreshLeadSeconds.description: A refresh is sent this long before the cache expires. 5 to 600, and at most half the cache lifetime.

idleLimitMinutes.title: Idle limit (minutes)
idleLimitMinutes.description: No refreshes once the last prompt is older than this. 1 to 720.

debugWarnings.title: Debug warnings
debugWarnings.description: For watching the cache: a warning line under the prompt and a counter in /cache-warm status when a request reads less than half of its input from a cache the footer shows as warm. A large pasted prompt can trigger it too.
